title: Data Scientist - Sports Analytics
raw_description: Join our sports analytics team as a Data Scientist. Essential: strong Python skills and hands-on experience with scikit-learn and statistical modelling (regression, time series, or similar). You should be comfortable building and evaluating predictive models, including backtesting against historical data. Experience with statsmodels is a strong plus. Knowledge of sports betting markets or bookmaker odds is highly desirable but not required. Some frontend exposure (React/TypeScript) to help visualise model output would be nice to have. A degree in statistics, mathematics, computer science or a related quantitative field is required.
